title: Pudding Boy Hop
description: Bounce a jiggly caramel pudding hero upward across sweet dessert platforms—chain springs and fruit boosts sky-high.
controls: Tap or drag to guide Pudding Boy onto each higher platform while dodging hazards.

zh-CN.title: Q弹布丁男孩
zh-CN.description: 软萌 Q 弹跳跃闯关布丁男孩：操控弹力十足的小布丁在甜品平台上步步高升，踩弹簧吃糖果直冲云霄！
zh-CN.controls: 滑动控制 Q 弹布丁精准落向更高层甜品平台，收集糖果刷新攀登纪录。
